source_operation_requirement: Independently authenticated normalized original camera date/hour intervals, complete physical station×all 82 dates; raw event source member independently confirmed.
site_pair_selection: For each physical station × one ORIGINAL ascending/descending date pair require POSITIVE verified camera operation hours in ALL THREE zones on BOTH original dates. Selection based ONLY on independent original camera operation exposure, never on species detections; all four species and all zero count cells retained.
operation_assigned_denominator: Detected events per 100 verified operational camera-hours summed over independent-operation-eligible station×date pairs within each branch and ecological zone. One source exposure denominator shared across 4 ungulates, no species-specific site selection.

rate_contrasts.ecology: negative shift => relative retreat from central daylight into daylight edges
positive shift => relative detected time-use redistribution from daylight to night

numerical_precommit: No pseudocount or imputation. When one rate in a contrast is zero or its independently verified exposure denominator is zero, report UNDEFINED_ZERO_EVENT rather than infinite/smoothed effect.
source_consistency: Every eligible source event time must fall within an independently attested original camera operation interval for that SAME station and original calendar date; otherwise HOLD_SOURCE_EVENT_OUTSIDE_VERIFIED_OPERATION rather than trusting one source over the other.
real_inference_bound: Descriptive effort-adjusted DETECTION rate allocation only; without independent source detector q cannot claim latent animal activity; site/date non-independence precludes treating raw counts as iid replicates.
negative_controls: A calendar-only attempt without source attestation must HOLD
Synthetic zone ratios identify core→edge and night→daylight redistribution separately
All 4 species, original station×pair roster and zero-event denominators preserved
A source event outside verified original camera operations must HOLD
